name: Valley iron-bound chest lock
notes: The padlock on the valley's fine, iron-bound chest in valley-02 (mw-ju8.20): the valley chest key, lying in the wooden chest across the glade, opens it from the keyring. A tier-2 lock a thief with lockpicks can pick at pick tier 2 (mw-e10 owns the minigame; the chest takes the same unlock and pick path as a door).
hint: Locked. An iron padlock; the key must be somewhere in the glade.
